provenance.what: Seventh live run: both golden sets under grounding policy g2, which made the context's own labels evidence. Motivated by a real-corpus field transcript (Azure gpt-4.1-mini as the only rung): three answers rejected in a row for 'inventing' figures - 17, 4, 5, 6, and the composite 4,5,6,8,10 the number regex swallowed whole - every one a chunk label the SOURCES block itself taught the model, plus one label-only answer refused as citing no sources. Under g2, header numbers (locator, title, document id) verify, and 'chunk N' references resolve to the retrieved chunk they name; a reference to an unretrieved chunk stays an invention. Each field rejection is pinned as a unit test.
provenance.models: Chat: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via llama-cpp-python (rebuilt natively after a container CPU migration). Embeddings: nomic-embed-text v1.5 Q4_K_M, task prefixes applied.
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline in full (11 documents); companion run on the repository documents/
provenance.hardware: 4-core CPU container, no GPU; both model servers local
provenance.caveat: These sets exercise the local model, which rarely echoes chunk labels; they prove g2 does no harm here. The behaviour g2 fixes was measured in the field on a frontier rung and is pinned by the unit tests, not by these corpora.
